shortDescription: Manages md-permissions-profile objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: cme_operations
options.description: Permission to read / edit the Cloud Management Extension (CME) configuration.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: default_profile_global_domains
options.description: Name or UID of the required default profile for all global domains.

options.name: default_profile_local_domains
options.description: Name or UID of the required default profile for all local domains.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER.

options.name: enable_default_profile_for_global_domains
options.displayName: Enable Default Profile For Global Domains
options.description: Enable the option to specify a default profile for all global domains.

options.name: enable_default_profile_for_local_domains
options.displayName: Enable Default Profile For Local Domains
options.description: Enable the option to specify a default profile for all local domains.

options.name: global_vpn_management
options.description:
Lets the administrator select Enable global use for a Security Gateway shown in the MDS Gateways & Servers view.
Only a 'Manager' permission-level profile can edit this permission.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: manage_admins
options.description:
Create and manage Multi-Domain Security Management administrators with the same or lower permission level. For example, a Domain manager cannot create Superusers or global managers.
Only a 'Manager' permission-level profile can edit this permission.

options.name: manage_global_assignments
options.description: Controls the ability to create, edit and delete global assignment and not the ability to reassign, which is set according to the specific Domain's permission profile.

options.name: manage_sessions
options.description:
Connect/disconnect Domain sessions, publish changes, and delete other administrator sessions.
Only a 'Manager' permission-level profile can edit this permission.

options.name: management_api_login
options.description:
Permission to log in to the Security Management Server and run API commands using these tools, mgmt_cli (Linux and Windows binaries), Gaia CLI (clish) and Web Services (REST). Useful if you want to prevent administrators from running automatic scripts on the Management.
Note, This permission is not required to run commands from within the API terminal in SmartConsole.

options.name: mds_provisioning
options.description:
Create and manage Multi-Domain Servers and Multi-Domain Log Servers.
Only a "Super User" permission-level profile can select this option.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: permission_level
options.description:
The level of the Multi Domain Permissions Profile.
The level cannot be changed after creation.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: view_global_objects_in_domain
options.description: Lets an administrator with no global objects permissions view the global objects in the domain. This option is required for valid domain management.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
